name: Varchenko-Factorizable Partial Cubes Form a Proper Subclass
scope: Finite simple COMs and their tope graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every member is a partial cube, and the containment is strict.
proof: The class definition assumes a partial cube. The partial cube $Q_4^{--}(4)$ has an explicitly computed residual determinant factor that is not of arrangement type.
